The goal is to document whether higher climate risk and lower\ncommunity resilience are associated with lower property values, conditional on\nobservables.\n\nThis is a **descriptive correlation**, not a causal estimate. Pull ACS controls and USDA urban/rural designation\n\nWe need county-level controls that the NRI components don't already capture:\n\n- **Median household income** - the largest non-NRI driver of housing value\n- **Coastal County Status** - account for coastal amenity and/or risk\n\nConsidered but left off due to overlap with community resilience and social vulnerability calculations:\n- **Share with bachelor's degree+** - human capital, picks up labor market quality\n- **Share owner-occupied** - tenure mix shifts price dynamics\n- **Median age** - lifecycle/retiree composition, related to migration patterns\n- **Median year structure built** - housing stock vintage, captures durability\n\nWe deliberately do *not* pull poverty, vehicle access, household size, or disability\nshare - those are inputs to the CDC SVI and would create multicollinearity with\n`sovi_score`.","metadata":{}},{"id":"9f65c819","cell_type":"code","source":"# Variables of interest from 2019-2023 5-year ACS\nacs_vars <- c(\n  median_hh_income    = \"B19013_001\",  # housing denominator\n  owner_units         = \"B25003_002\",  # owner-occupied\n  median_age          = \"B01002_001\",\n  median_yr_built     = \"B25035_001\"\n)\n\nacs_raw <- get_acs(\n  geography = \"county\",\n  variables = acs_vars,\n  year      = 2023,\n  survey    = \"acs5\",\n  output    = \"wide\",\n  cache_table = TRUE\n)\n\ncat(\"ACS counties pulled:\", nrow(acs_raw), \"\\n\")","metadata":{"name":"acs-pull","cache":true,"trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"75cad903","cell_type":"code","source":"# Direct download from USDA ERS\n# rucc_url <- \"https://www.ers.usda.gov/sites/default/files/_laserfiche/DataFiles/53251/Ruralurbancontinuumcodes2023.xlsx\"\nrucc_file <- \"../data/raw/rucc.xlsx\"\n# download.file(rucc_url, destfile = rucc_file, mode = \"wb\")","metadata":{"trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"8a626a9d","cell_type":"code","source":"rucc <- read_excel(rucc_file, sheet = 1) %>%\n  transmute(\n    stcofips = sprintf(\"%05d\", as.integer(FIPS)),\n    rucc_2023 = as.integer(RUCC_2023),\n    # Merge and finalize variables","metadata":{}},{"id":"e000db87","cell_type":"code","source":"df <- hed %>%\n  inner_join(acs, by = \"stcofips\") %>%\n  mutate(\n    # Outcome\n    log_zhvi          = log(zhvi),\n    # NRI in logs (multiplicative form: log(risk) = log(eal) + log(crf))\n    log_eal           = log(eal_valt + 1),\n    log_crf           = log(crf_value),\n    log_risk          = log(risk_value + 1),\n    log_resl_value    = log(resl_value),\n    # ACS controls in logs / standardized\n    log_income        = log(median_hh_income),\n    log_pop_density   = log(pmax(pop_density, 1e-3)),\n    # Standardized scores for interpretable coefficients\n    sovi_score_z      = as.numeric(scale(sovi_score)),\n    resl_score_z      = as.numeric(scale(resl_score)),\n    resl_value_z      = as.numeric(scale(resl_value))\n  ) %>%\n  filter(is.finite(log_zhvi), is.finite(log_eal), is.finite(log_resl_value))\n\ncat(\"Final analytic rows:\", format(nrow(df), big.mark = \",\"), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Counties:           \", n_distinct(df$stcofips), \"\\n\")","metadata":{"name":"merge","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"12234d86","cell_type":"code","source":"df %>%\n  distinct(stcofips, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%\n  group_by(rucc_2023) %>%\n  summarise(\n    n_counties     = n(),\n    mean_resl      = mean(resl_value, na.rm = TRUE),\n    mean_zhvi      = mean(zhvi, na.rm = TRUE),\n    mean_income    = mean(median_hh_income, na.rm = TRUE)\n  )","metadata":{"lines_to_next_cell":2,"trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"1f6f935b","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 5. Model specifications\n\nWe run three specifications side by side. All use **state + month fixed effects** with\nstandard errors clustered at the county level.\n\n- **Spec A (controls):** ZHVI ~ log(income) + log(pop_density) + coastal\n- **Spec B (parsimonious, NRI's intended decomposition):** ZHVI ~ log(EAL) + log(CRF)\n- **Spec C (separates resilience from social vulnerability):** ZHVI ~ log(EAL) + resilience + SoVI\n- **Spec D (Spec B + regime interaction):** allow SoVI coefficient to differ pre/post March 2023\n- **Spec E (Spec B - Sovi):** check if resilience multicollinearity with sovi impacts coefficient\n- **Spec F (Spec B - income):** check to see what income is absorbing from the NRI values\n  to flag whether the HVRI→CDC methodology change shifts the apparent SoVI premium\n- **Spec G (Spec B + urban-rural continuum): *** see if resilience coefficient changes when urban/ruralness accounted for","metadata":{}},{"id":"b834cdb5","cell_type":"code","source":"# Note: removed controls included in community resilience: share_bach_plus, share_owner_occ. Age partially included in social vulnerability calculation. Income also partially included, but keeping it as a separate control\nctrls <- \"log_income + log_pop_density + coastal\"\nfe    <- \"state + month_id\"\n\nspec_A <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ \", ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\nspec_B <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + log_crf +\", ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\nspec_C <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + resl_value_z + sovi_score_z +\", ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\nspec_D <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + resl_value_z + sovi_score_z + sovi_score_z:cdc_svi_regime +\",\n  ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\nspec_E <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + resl_value_z +\",\n  ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\nctrls <- \"log_pop_density + coastal\"\nspec_F <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + resl_value_z + sovi_score_z +\",\n  ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))\n\n# add urban/rural continuum to fixed effects\nctrls <- \"log_income + log_pop_density + coastal\"\nfe <- \"state + month_id + factor(rucc_2023)\"\nspec_G <- as.formula(paste(\n  \"log_zhvi ~ log_eal + resl_value_z + sovi_score_z +\", \n  ctrls, \"|\", fe\n))","metadata":{"name":"specs","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"1ab5e83c","cell_type":"code","source":"mA <- feols(spec_A, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmB <- feols(spec_B, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmC <- feols(spec_C, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmD <- feols(spec_D, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmE <- feols(spec_E, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmF <- feols(spec_F, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\nmG <- feols(spec_G, data = df, cluster = ~ stcofips)\n\netable(mA, mB, mC, mD, mE, mF, mG,\n       title = \"Hedonic regression: log(ZHVI) on NRI components and controls\",\n       digits  = 3,\n       fitstat = c(\"n\", \"r2\", \"war2\"))","metadata":{"name":"fit","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"11779e02","cell_type":"code","source":"# Urban/rural control comparison\netable(mB, mF, headers = c(\"No RUCC\", \"RUCC FE\"), digits = 3)","metadata":{"lines_to_next_cell":2,"trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"7cc4cfee","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 6. Interpretation guide\n\nFor continuous logged predictors (`log_eal`, `log_crf`, `log_income`, `log_pop_density`):\neach coefficient is approximately the percent change in ZHVI per 1% change in the predictor\n(elasticity).\n\nFor standardized predictors (`resl_value_z`, `sovi_score_z`): coefficients are the percent\nchange in ZHVI per **1 standard deviation** increase in the predictor.\n\nFor the binary `coastal` and the `share_*` and `median_age` controls: coefficients are\npercent change in ZHVI per unit change.\n\n**Expected directions if markets price climate risk and resilience:**\n\n- `log_eal` < 0: higher expected losses → lower prices\n- `log_crf` < 0: higher community risk factor → lower prices\n- `resl_value_z` > 0: more resilient community → higher prices\n- `sovi_score_z` likely < 0 but interpretation is mostly about the population, not climate\n- `coastal` > 0 (and probably large): the amenity premium swamps the risk discount in raw form\n\nThe regime-interaction term in Spec C tests whether the SoVI coefficient shifts when\nthe underlying SoVI methodology changes. A large, significant interaction means we\ncan't interpret the pooled SoVI coefficient cleanly.\n\n## 7. Robustness","metadata":{}},{"id":"47f64690","cell_type":"code","source":"# R1: drop coastal counties entirely (test whether non-coastal risk has its own pricing)\nm_nocoast <- feols(spec_C,\n                   data = df %>% filter(coastal == 0),\n                   cluster = ~ stcofips)\n\n# R2: state-clustered SEs (more conservative)\nm_state_cluster <- feols(spec_C, data = df, cluster = ~ state)\n\n# R3: 2023+ subsample only (CDC SVI regime, single methodology)\nm_2023plus <- feols(spec_C,\n                    data = df %>% filter(cdc_svi_regime == 1),\n                    cluster = ~ stcofips)\n\n# R4: 2020-2022 subsample only (HVRI SoVI regime)\nm_pre2023 <- feols(spec_C,\n                   data = df %>% filter(cdc_svi_regime == 0),\n                   cluster = ~ stcofips)\n\netable(mC, m_nocoast, m_state_cluster, m_2023plus, m_pre2023,\n       headers = c(\"Main\", \"Inland only\", \"State cluster\", \"CDC regime\", \"HVRI regime\"),\n       title   = \"Robustness checks against Spec B\",\n       digits  = 3,\n       fitstat = c(\"n\", \"r2\"))","metadata":{"name":"robustness","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"a19bf2d1","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 7b. Cross-section robustness: one observation per county per NRI vintage\n\nLoads the collapsed dataset built in `06_hedonic.ipynb`: one row per county per NRI\nvintage, with mean ZHVI over each vintage's coverage window. Sample drops from ~189k\nto ~9k.\n\n**Why this matters:**\n\n- **Sidesteps the time-invariance issue with ACS controls.** In the panel, our 2019-2023\n  ACS income is matched against ZHVI from 2020-2025 - real income changed over those\n  years, so the static income variable carries measurement error that attenuates the\n  income coefficient and lets correlated variables (resilience, coastal, density)\n  absorb the missing income trend. Collapsing to one observation per vintage with mean\n  ZHVI over a window inside the ACS span eliminates the mismatch.\n- **Removes within-county serial correlation.** County clustering in the panel is\n  designed to handle this, but a true cross-section avoids the issue entirely.\n- **Matches resolution of NRI updates.** NRI is a vintage-anchored measurement, not a\n  smoothly varying signal. The cross-section respects that data structure.\n\nIf point estimates are similar to the panel, that's evidence the panel findings\nare not artifacts of time-aggregation choices. If they differ meaningfully, the\ncross-section should be preferred.","metadata":{}},{"id":"2a21b159","cell_type":"code","source":"xsec <- read_csv(\"../data/processed/hedonic_xsec.csv\",\n                 col_types = cols(\n                   stcofips        = col_character(),\n                   state           = col_character(),\n                   stateabbrv      = col_character(),\n                   county          = col_character(),\n                   window_start    = col_date(),\n                   window_end      = col_date(),\n                   n_months        = col_integer(),\n                   nri_vintage     = col_integer(),\n                   cdc_svi_regime  = col_integer(),\n                   coastal         = col_integer(),\n                   .default        = col_double()\n                 ))\n\ncat(\"Cross-section rows: \", nrow(xsec), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Counties per vintage:\\n\")\nprint(table(xsec$nri_vintage))","metadata":{"name":"xsec-load","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"e95df7a5","cell_type":"markdown","source":"### Income data for the cross-section\n\n**ACS 5-year, vintage-matched** is the median income source because it matches the analysis approach used in most published\nhedonic real estate work. Vintage window-end aligned with NRI release (*one year lag for 2025 as 2021-2025 data not yet available).","metadata":{}},{"id":"0c7bf480","cell_type":"code","source":"# Pull ACS for each vintage and stack\nfetch_acs <- function(end_year) {\n  get_acs(\n    geography = \"county\",\n    variables = c(median_hh_income = \"B19013_001\"),\n    year      = end_year,\n    survey    = \"acs5\",\n    output    = \"wide\",\n    cache_table = TRUE\n  ) %>%\n    transmute(\n      stcofips         = GEOID,\n      median_hh_income = median_hh_incomeE,\n      acs_end_year     = end_year\n    ) %>%\n    filter(!is.na(median_hh_income))\n}\n\nacs_xs <- bind_rows(\n  fetch_acs(2020) %>% mutate(nri_vintage = 2020L),\n  fetch_acs(2021) %>% mutate(nri_vintage = 2021L),\n  fetch_acs(2023) %>% mutate(nri_vintage = 2023L),\n  fetch_acs(2024) %>% mutate(nri_vintage = 2025L)\n) %>%\n  select(stcofips, nri_vintage, median_hh_income, acs_end_year)\n\ncat(\"ACS vintage-matched rows:\", Attrition ledger: NRI∩ZHVI → +ACS → +finite-logs\nattrition_ledger <- pre_acs_counts %>%\n  left_join(post_acs_counts,    by = \"nri_vintage\") %>%\n  left_join(post_filter_counts, by = \"nri_vintage\") %>%\n  mutate(\n    drop_acs    = n_pre_acs - n_post_acs,\n    drop_logs   = n_post_acs - n_final\n  )\n\ncat(\"Cross-section attrition by Compare to a 5% benchmark\n(rough perpetuity discount on annual losses).","metadata":{}},{"id":"ac5423a1","cell_type":"code","source":"beta_eal <- coef(mB)[\"log_eal\"]\n\n# Median ZHVI and median EAL in the sample\nmed_zhvi <- median(df$zhvi)\nmed_eal  <- median(df$eal_valt)\n\n# Implied $ change in ZHVI from a $1 change in EAL (at the medians)\nimplied_dollar <- beta_eal * med_zhvi / med_eal\n\ncat(\"β on log(EAL):                       \", round(beta_eal, 4), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Implied $-discount per $ of annual EAL:\", round(implied_dollar, 2), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Benchmark (5% rate, perpetuity):       -20.00\\n\")\ncat(\"Example: \", -0.00225 * 300000 / 4000000,\"\\n\")\ncat(\"\\nIf the implied figure is ~-20, the market is pricing risk near a 5% rate.\\n\")\ncat(\"If it's ~ -2, the market is pricing risk near a 50% rate (heavy discount).\\n\")\ncat(\"If it's near 0 or positive, the market is essentially ignoring risk.\\n\")","metadata":{"name":"implied-rate","trusted":true},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"39e080e8","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 9. Caveats and what this analysis cannot establish\n\nThis regression measures *correlation conditional on observables*. The county-level\ncoastal dummy and ACS controls do not fully purge amenity bias (people pay more to\nlive near oceans regardless of climate risk). The hedonic coefficient is therefore a\n**lower bound on the true risk discount in absolute terms** - the market may discount\nrisk more than we measure, but the amenity premium is netting against it.\n\nThe SoVI methodology break in March 2023 means the pooled-sample SoVI coefficient\nmixes two different measurements. The regime-interaction term in Spec C and the\nstratified robustness checks test whether this matters in practice.\n\nZHVI is smoothed and seasonally adjusted. For the cross-sectional question this\nmatters less than for the event study, but month-to-month price discovery is\nattenuated.\n\nThe event study (notebook `05`) provides a complementary, less amenity-confounded\ntest of whether markets *update* when risk is realized via storm.","metadata":{}}]}
